messages:
mike: seeing a 3x p99 increase from brussels POP since 09:03 UTC. affecting a small set of tenants, throughput steady but tail latency up. graphs: https://grafana/redwood/d/abcd1234/brussels-pop
perf-bot: ALERT perf-p99-high brussels-pop p99=980ms baseline=220ms hosts=[brus-01,brus-02]
anya: oncall here, i'm looking. mike can you drop kvcache evictions and kernel selection flips for brus-01?
kevin: runtime, grabbing traces now. i already see kernel selector oscillating on brus-01 between "int8-optim" and "safe-fp16" every ~30s. suspect noisy tenant causing mem pressure -> kernel fallback.
mike: sample trace snippet: ```kernel_switch pid=2234 reason=oom_kv_cache free=120MB->18MB batch_wait=12ms -> fallback to safe-fp16```
kevin: that batch_wait=12ms is above our heuristic. batching grows, allocs spike, kvcache starts evicting aggressively, then selector flips back. kv evictions: ```kvcache.evictions{host=brus-01} +2400 in 5m```
anya: net team - any peering/dns work in the window? transient DNS/route issues could amplify request latency and make batching decisions worse.
tom: net here. peering steady, but we rolled a small LDNS tweak for brussels earlier; dns logs show a subset of resolutions at ~1.2s which is abnormal. also seeing some packet drops on host brus-01's NIC queue.
sre-bot: host metrics brus-01: cpu-steal spike at 09:02, noisy VM id=vm-842, net rx drops ~200/s, iowait up.
kevin: noisy tenant vm-842 is colocated on same NUMA domain as our workers. selector uses local perf counters (cache-miss, ipc). when those counters spike we pick safe-fp16 which increases memory use and latency. vicious loop.
anya: mitigation plan: 1) cordon vm-842 (sre) 2) temp pin kernel to int8-optim on brus-01 for affected model families (runtime) 3) reduce batch_wait threshold from 12ms->6ms to avoid runaway batch growth 4) trigger kvcache soft-eviction cleanup
tom: cordoned vm-842 and migrated guests off. host rx drops reduced, cpu-steal trending back to baseline.
kevin: applying temp kernel pin (brus-01): ```PATCH /runtime/config
{ "kernel_prefs": { "model_family": "mistral*", "prefer": "int8-optim", "until": "09:50Z" } }
```
mike: metrics update: after cordon+pin p99 dropped to ~240ms within 3m, kvcache evictions down to +40 in 5m. throughput stable.
anya: keeping monitoring. follow-ups: add host-level noisy-tenant detector to alert earlier; smooth kernel selector inputs (exponential smoothing over 60s of perf counters) to avoid flip-flop; add kvcache eviction alert when >200/min.
kevin: opened runtime ticket INF-3421 with attached perf traces, flamegraphs, and the kernel flip timeline.
mike: thanks all — marking incident as mitigated for now :white_check_mark: will reopen if we see regressions.
